svg.title: Local Reference condition and safe exits
svg.desc: Local file verification and server-head verification are independent observations. Exact plus Current permits ordinary Reference use. Modified plus Current may convert to Checkout only after a fresh server grant. OutOfDate, Missing, Unreadable or either Unknown condition preserves local work and blocks any claim that it is current or publishable until an explicit safe path and revalidation succeed.
